text_ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَعِيلُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَيْسَ لَنَا مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ الْعَائِدُ فِي هِبَتِهِ كَالْكَلْبِ يَعُودُ فِي قَيْئِهِ
text_ar_search:
أخبرنا عمرو بن زرارة قال حدثنا إسمعيل عن أيوب عن عكرمة عن ابن عباس قال
قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليس لنا مثل السوء العائد في هبته كالكلب يعود في قيئه
text_en: It was narrated that Muhammad said: "I do not know that Shuraih ever ruled on Mudarabah disputes except in two ways. He would say to the Mudarib (the one who contributed his labor to the partnership): 'You must provide proof that a calamity befell you so that you may be excused.' Or he would say to the one who invested his money in the partnership: 'You must provide proof that your trustee betrayed his trust, otherwise his oath sworn by Allah that he did not betray you is sufficient.'"
text_id: Telah mengabarkan kepada kami ['Amru bin Zurarah] berkata; telah menceritakan kepada kami [Isma'il] dari [Ayyub] dari ['Ikrimah] dari [Ibnu Abbas] berkata, "Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Kita tidak memiliki permisalan yang buruk, sesungguhnya orang yang mengambil kembali pemberiannya seperti anjing yang memakan kembali muntahannya."
